summary: Olenox Industries Inc. filed an 8-K on May 28, 2026, reporting its acquisition of 100% of CS Digital Ventures, LLC via a Membership Interest Purchase Agreement dated May 26, 2026. The aggregate consideration includes $14M in Series D Preferred Stock (stated value $1/share), a $16M unsecured promissory note, warrants to purchase 1.5M common shares (3 tranches at $5, $7, $9), and up to $20M in earnout shares based on revenue/Adjusted EBITDA milestones. The Series D stock and warrants have a conversion/exercise gate requiring stockholder approval per Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635. Watch for shareholder vote timing and earnout milestones as key arbitrage catalysts.
